profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Distributed Systems Architect | High-Scale Data, Applied AI & Platform Reliability
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing and scaling distributed systems, customer communication platforms, and privacy‑driven data flows for large‑scale retail environments. I specialize in turning ambiguous business problems into clear, extensible architectures and driving alignment across engineering, product, SRE, and vendor partners.

My work spans enterprise communications, Pro customer experiences, data privacy governance, observability, and platform modernization. I’m known for reducing operational complexity, improving reliability, mentoring senior engineers, and shaping long‑term technical strategy. I thrive in roles where architecture, leadership, and cross‑org influence intersect

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Software Engineer supporting Customer Technology and Pro & Customer Platforms. Focus areas include enterprise communications architecture, data privacy, vendor strategy, observability, and cross-org leadership. Responsible for 2 key areas including Enterprise preference center, customer data privacy and governance,  and Customer Communications. 

1️⃣ Enterprise Preference Center (EPC) — Preference Architecture & Customer Configuration
🔹 Unified Architecture: Architected a standardized, single-source-of-truth preference model and led API contract design across Loyalty, Customer Service, and Pro platforms to ensure consistent cross-domain data handling.
🔹 Performance & Delivery: Defined enterprise-wide caching strategies and consolidated disparate data models, optimizing system performance and significantly accelerating time-to-market for new platform capabilities.

2️⃣ Customer Data Privacy & Governance — High-Scale Resilience & Security
🔹 System Scalability: Architected and executed scaling strategies to seamlessly support a 10x growth in privacy-related traffic (scaling from 20 to 200+ TPS).
🔹 Engineering Standardization: Translated complex security reviews into actionable engineering paths and modernized legacy 3rd-party governance codebases into fully automated CI/CD pipelines.

3️⃣ Customer Communications — Cloud Optimization & Modernization
🔹 Event-Driven Transformation: Defined the 2-year strategic roadmap to transition legacy communication systems to a modern, event-driven architecture, ultimately reducing the cloud compute footprint by 50%.
🔹 Vendor Strategy & Integration: Led the technical discovery and integration of a self-service template vendor, slashing capability development time from months to weeks.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Staff Software Engineer driving cloud-native modernization and platform observability. Focus areas include distributed messaging architectures, microservices development (Go, Java), CI/CD automation, and engineering enablement. Responsible for 3 key areas including Enterprise Messaging & Observability, Cloud-Native Engineering, and Technical Enablement.

1️⃣ Enterprise Messaging & Observability — Infrastructure Scale & Resilience
🔹 High-Scale Messaging: Led the transition and support of a massive enterprise messaging (MQ) infrastructure spanning 2,200+ retail locations, engineering a centralized visibility application for unified queue and topic monitoring.
🔹 System Observability & Testing: Implemented Open Tracing (Zipkin) for microservices and built a custom Golang testing harness to simulate load generation across Apache Kafka and Google Pub/Sub.

2️⃣ Cloud-Native Engineering & Microservices — Architecture & Code Delivery
🔹 Event-Driven Development: Designed 12-factor microservice APIs and streaming data pipelines utilizing Java, Go, BigQuery, and Pub/Sub, integrated with serverless cloud functions.
🔹 Infrastructure Automation: Architected a custom DNS management service for multi-cloud URL routing, integrated OAuth2 identity services, and built robust automated CI/CD pipelines using Concourse-CI and Bash.

3️⃣ Technical Enablement & Agile Leadership — Culture & Upskilling
🔹 Technical Instruction: Served as a primary technical instructor ("Orange Method"), personally teaching Go and modern distributed systems methodologies to 100+ engineers.
🔹 Agile Transformation: Drove engineering culture shifts by introducing TDD/BDD and pair programming, successfully onboarding new engineering teams, and stepping up to lead sprint ceremonies and agile workflows.

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer-Infrastructure Middleware Design
positions.description:
-Designed and created an automated queue request and creation script
to support a large program that was requesting 100s of queues a week
which cut prep time down from a week to 2 days.
-Designed and developed a trigger monitor for ActiveMQ using Java to
automate the starting of applications allowing legacy applications to
function as they did with WebSphere MQ’s triggering.
-Fully automated the deployment of Camel routes to ServiceMix to
support over 8,000 potential remote nodes when nodes changed or
became available.
-Developed repeatable testing patterns for MQ to ensure quality and
consistency across hundreds of customer projects.
-Created a design to replace WebSphere MQ with ActiveMQ in stores
while seamlessly bridging to and from 2 major WebSphere MQ clusters
consisting of over 200 QManagers and 1000s of queues.
-Designed MQ shared environments to provide a cost and time saving
uses of messaging products through the consolidation of infrastructure
resources.

positions.title: Systems Engineer-Middleware Support
positions.description: Provide domestic and international support for one of the largest MQ Series installations in the world across AIX, HP-UX, Linux, Windows and Mainframe.  Involved in senior-level team functions including change control and ticket checks, budget and project planning for the year.

positions.title: MQ Admin
positions.description:
-Assisted in creating and maintaining a WebSphere MQ administration
  web tool written in Java.
-Build and design WebSphere MQ network architecture between
  multiple applications over several nodes.
-Managed clustered WebSphere MQ objects and provide support for
  approximately 90 queue managers.
